provenance.method: Cloned at the pinned SHA and read the source. Every expectedFile and every expectedLines range below was verified against the actual file at that SHA — nothing here is inferred from the repository's reputation or from memory.
provenance.measures: The tree-sitter parsing + CPG pipeline from V3-P1 (ANALYZER_VERSION 1.1.0). A pre-V3-P1 regex-parsed run of the same repo is NOT comparable against these numbers, because symbol extraction changed.
provenance.whyThisRepo: Small, real, pure-ESM JavaScript with a genuine internal structure (public entry, utilities, two vendored subsystems). It exercises the JS grammar, relative-import resolution, and the `#ansi-styles` subpath-imports case that our resolver deliberately does NOT resolve — so the graph's `unresolved` tally is exercised honestly rather than avoided.
provenance.thresholdStatus: EVAL_THRESHOLDS are still PLACEHOLDERS. Calibrate them from the out-of-band scored run against this dataset before any gating decision.
